hardpan.name: Hollis "Hardpan" McCrae
hardpan.title: Wildcatter
hardpan.taunt: Ain't nobody smells oil like ol' Hardpan.
hardpan.lose: Well, I'll be. Beginner's luck, kid.

dolores.name: Dolores Vance
dolores.title: Rancher's Widow
dolores.taunt: This was cattle country before your daddy was born.
dolores.lose: Hmph. Keep your boots off my fences.

pickett.name: Judge Amos Pickett
pickett.title: County Judge
pickett.taunt: In this county, I decide whose lease is legal.

ruby.name: Ruby Carrow
ruby.title: Rodeo Queen
ruby.taunt: I've been thrown by meaner broncs than you.

blackwood.name: Cyrus Blackwood
blackwood.title: Eastern Financier
blackwood.taunt: Everything in Texas is for sale. Including you.

maps.title: First Lease
maps.intro: 1938. You've got eighty grand, a borrowed rig and one rival: a loud wildcatter who swears he can smell crude.
maps.background_desc: Morning, 1938. A single borrowed wooden derrick stands on a bare, fenced lease at the edge of a tiny boomtown. Pale blue sky going gold at the horizon, flat tan dirt, a few mesquite bushes, a beat-up flatbed truck. In the distance, a second crooked derrick with a hand-painted sign nailed to it (Hardpan's). Hopeful and empty: lots of open sky.

maps.title: Dry Creek Gamble
maps.intro: Hardpan wants a rematch on a field half the town calls cursed.
maps.background_desc: Hot noon over a dried-up creek bed: cracked mud, bleached cattle skull, dead cottonwood trees, a rope bridge over nothing. Two or three abandoned dry-hole derricks lean at angles, one with a crude 'CURSED' board. Heat-shimmer haze, washed-out white-yellow sky.

maps.title: The Widow's Fences
maps.intro: Dolores Vance owns half the county and doesn't take kindly to derricks on her horizon.
maps.background_desc: Late afternoon ranch land. Long barbed-wire fences run toward the horizon, a big white ranch house on a rise with a windmill, longhorn cattle grazing. A 'NO DRILLING - VANCE RANCH' sign on a fence post. Warm orange light, long shadows. Lots of fence lines.

maps.title: Saturday Night Boomtown
maps.intro: The boomtown never sleeps. Neither does Dolores.
maps.background_desc: Night in the boomtown's main street: wooden false-front buildings, saloon and dance hall with lit windows, string lights, a few Model-A trucks, mud in the street. Derricks with lanterns on the dark hills behind. Deep blue-purple sky with stars, warm yellow window light.

maps.title: Two-Front War
maps.intro: Hardpan and Dolores have teamed up to run you out of town.
maps.background_desc: Dusk on the edge of town, two camps facing off: on the left Hardpan's ramshackle wildcat rig and tent, on the right Dolores's fenced ranch gate. Your lone derrick between them in the middle distance. Stormy orange-red sky, dust kicking up. A showdown feel.

maps.title: Piney Woods
maps.intro: East Texas, 1941. The fields are bigger, and so are the egos.
maps.background_desc: 1941, East Texas. Tall dark-green pine forest with a clearing full of new derricks packed close together, red clay roads, a sawmill with smoke. Morning mist between the trees. Cooler greens and red-brown earth: a clear change from the dusty first chapter.

maps.title: Order in the Court
maps.intro: Judge Amos Pickett rules on every lease dispute in the county. Guess whose side he's on.
maps.background_desc: A small-town county courthouse square: red-brick courthouse with a clock tower and columns, a Texas flag, parked 1940s cars, a bench of old men whittling. Derricks visible behind the rooftops. Bright midday, clean blue sky. Pickett's territory: it should feel official and a little smug.

maps.title: Rail Spur Rights
maps.intro: The new rail spur makes some plots worth twice as much. Pickett already knows which ones.
maps.background_desc: A railroad spur cutting through the pines: steam locomotive pulling tank cars, a wooden water tower, a loading rack, survey stakes with little flags along the track. Late afternoon sun through the trees, steam clouds. Plots near the rails look valuable.

maps.title: Hung Jury
maps.intro: Three tycoons, one field, no mercy.
maps.background_desc: Rainy evening in the piney woods: dark sky, steady rain streaks, puddles in the red clay, derricks lit by work lights, a boarded-up courthouse window lit from inside. Moody greys and greens with warm lamp highlights. Three rivals' rigs crowded together.

maps.title: The Old Layout
maps.intro: An old-timer's field on the classic survey lines. Three strata, twelve notches, nowhere to hide.
maps.background_desc: An old surveyor's field on a clear day: a weathered survey map pinned to a board in the foreground corner, chain-link survey marks, straight fence lines on a grid, an old-timer's shack and rocking chair. Faded, slightly sepia colors, like an old photograph. Calm and orderly.

maps.title: Permian Dawn
maps.intro: 1946. West Texas, flat as a skillet and twice as hot. A rodeo queen has bought in.
maps.background_desc: 1946, West Texas at dawn. Endless flat land, a huge sky with a pink-orange sunrise, distant mesas, pump jacks starting to appear. A rodeo arena fence and a horse trailer with Ruby's red-and-white colors at one side. Wide and open: the horizon sits low.

maps.title: Bronc Busting
maps.intro: Ruby Carrow drills like she rides: fast and reckless.
maps.background_desc: A dusty rodeo ground next to the oil field: wooden bucking chutes, bleachers, flags, a bronc mid-buck, dust clouds. Derricks right behind the arena. Bright, hot, saturated: red, white and dusty gold. Loud and reckless energy.

maps.title: Caprock Country
maps.intro: The caprock hides deep oil. Expensive to find, rich when you do.
maps.background_desc: Caprock escarpment: a tall layered red-and-cream rock cliff splitting the land into high and low ground, a few big expensive steel derricks on top, a winding dirt road up the cliff. Late-day light making the rock layers glow. Should hint at deep oil (visible rock strata).

maps.title: Pipeline Fever
maps.intro: Everybody's laying pipe into everybody else's land. Keep your cash cushion fat.
maps.background_desc: A tangle of pipelines across the flat land: pipes on wooden trestles crossing each other, valve wheels, a pumping station, workers laying a new line, stacks of pipe. Hazy hot sky. Busy and crowded, steel greys against tan dirt.

maps.title: Sandstorm
maps.intro: A dust storm blows in. When it clears, only the strong are still drilling.
maps.background_desc: A dust storm rolling in: a giant brown wall of dust on the horizon swallowing the far derricks, the sky turning orange-brown, tumbleweeds, a windsock straight out, near derricks still standing in silhouette. Heavy, dramatic, low visibility at the edges.

maps.title: Gulf Breeze
maps.intro: 1951. Salt air, big money, and a banker from back East asking questions.
maps.background_desc: 1951, the Gulf Coast. Sandy shore with sea oats, a wooden pier, shrimp boats, a few derricks standing in the shallow water on platforms. Soft blue-green sea and a bright pastel sky with seagulls. A shiny black 1950s sedan parked on the shore road: the banker has arrived.

maps.title: Hostile Takeover
maps.intro: Cyrus Blackwood doesn't drill. He buys whoever does.
maps.background_desc: A port city waterfront: a big refinery with tanks and flare stacks, a bank building with 'BLACKWOOD TRUST' over the door, tankers at the dock, gulls. Cooler, colder colors with purple-grey shadows. Money and smokestacks: it should feel corporate and cold.

maps.title: Hurricane Season
maps.intro: Storm clouds over the Gulf. Five barons, one coastline.
maps.background_desc: Hurricane coming: dark green-grey storm clouds, palm trees bending, big waves crashing over a seawall, offshore derricks in the surf, a wind-torn flag, sideways rain. The most dramatic and dark of the coast backgrounds.

maps.title: The Big Board
maps.intro: Every rival you've ever beaten, on one enormous field. Blackwood is bankrolling them all.
maps.background_desc: A huge oil field seen from a hill: hundreds of derricks to the horizon, pipelines everywhere, a growing 1950s city skyline far behind. Five rival camps with their colored flags on the hills (Hardpan, Dolores, Pickett, Ruby, Blackwood). Golden-hour light. Epic and crowded.

maps.title: King of Texas
maps.intro: The final showdown. Win this and there's no one left to call you a beginner.
maps.background_desc: The finale: night over a big Texas city skyline with lit skyscrapers and searchlights sweeping the sky, a giant derrick in the foreground lit up like a monument, fireworks or a burning flare stack. Deep navy sky with gold lights: a triumphant, 'king of Texas' feel.

map_note: pos = [x, y] of each map's spot on the campaign world map (640x360, matching assets/ui/campaign_map.png; keep x under 345, the briefing panel covers the right side). Chapter label_pos = [x, y] of the region sign.
background_note: background = 640x360 art for that level. It shows full-screen behind the level's title card before the match, then dimmed behind the match board. background_desc is the art brief (copied into asset_requests/).
board_note: board_theme = decoration theme (data/board_kit.json) used to auto-fill data/boards/level_XX.json.
